info.name: woo-review-triage — the request is the authorisation container of its review records
info.description:
woo-review-triage tasks 6.1 and 6.2 (REQ-WRT-006). Folder `schemas` reads the seven review records back (documentReview, reviewBatch, triageRule, wooSearchPlan, wooExclusion, wooCollectionQuery, wooDeliveredSet) and asserts authorization.scope is private, no group reads them for all users, and no hierarchy key is declared. Folder `scoped` sets up two Woo cases and a reviewer in a batch of one, then lists documentReview, triageRule and reviewBatch through the OpenRegister API as that reviewer: only the own batch's review and batch are listed, no rule, nothing of the other case; the handler is the control. Setup provisions three accounts (handler, reviewer, colleague with the other batches), two throwaway Woo cases of the seeded Woo case type and three in-scope documents; teardown removes them.

@newman exclude Runs on the live pass through tests/newman/run-all.sh (decision 139): it provisions accounts and needs the seeded Woo case type and OpenRegister's private scope and per-object grants, which the CI newman job (enable-newman false, newman-collection-path 'data') does not set up. See the comment on enable-newman in .github/workflows/code-quality.yml.
